title: evidencepack/collector-build@v1
description: A collector build: its name, version, and commit, the schemas it checks its artifacts against, and its trace map. It describes the build rather than the run, so every run of one build writes the same bytes, at every level.

name.description: The collector's name, as its spec declares it.

version.description: The collector's version, such as v0.4.0. Absent when the build set none.

commit.description: The source commit the collector was built from. Absent when the build set none.

schemas.description: The JSON Schema each data artifact was checked against, keyed by artifact path or schema ID. A normalized type the collector gives its own methods for appears as the SDK's schema for the type with those methods. An artifact of a normalized type with no schema here was checked against the SDK's own schema for its type.

writes.description: The schema IDs of the artifacts the collector can write, sorted, such as evidencepack/vcs-posture@v1. Absent for a collector that lists none.

trace_map.description: The collector's trace map, which links each field to the calls and the code behind it. Absent for a collector without one.

artifacts.description: Each artifact's fields, by artifact path and then by JSON pointer, with each array index written as *. The empty pointer stands for the whole artifact.

lines.description: The text of each source line the fields name, by its file, relative to the collector's module root, and its line number.

suites.description: The test kit suites the map was built from, sorted by name: how the collector was tested. Absent from a map built before suites were kept.

name.description: The suite's name, which is the collector's unless the suite sets one.

operations.description: The operations the suite declares, sorted. Empty for a suite that declares none, which the kit reports.

scenarios.description: How many scenarios the suite runs.

recordings.description: How many of the scenarios are recordings of the test account.

waivers.description: The checks the suite turns off or softens, sorted by check and subject. Absent when the suite waives nothing.

check.description: The kit check the waiver turns off, or the softening: fault, insensitive, capped, ordered, ignore, or ignored_field.

subject.description: What the softening applies to: a fault, an operation, an artifact path and pointer prefix, or an operation and field pattern.

reason.description: Why the check does not apply.

expires.description: The date the waiver lapses, as YYYY-MM-DD. From that day the kit runs the check again.

operations.description: The operations whose failure leaves the field out or changes it, from the test kit's fault matrix over each suite's clean scenario.

code.description: Source lines behind the field, from static analysis of the collector's source. Analysis can miss a line, so they are a guide for reading the source.

gaps.description: The lines that record a gap for the field, from the gap sources the fault matrix's runs record.

copies.description: For a normalized field, the detailed fields it copies, from the collector's Mirror calls.

role.description: assign for a line that assigns the field, input for one that changes a value the assignment is computed from, condition for the test of an if, loop, or case such a line sits under or a check before it that skips the rest of a loop, and helper for a function the assignment calls.

end.description: For a helper, the last line of its function. Every line from line to end is in lines.

line.description: A file relative to the collector's module root and a line number, such as internal/collector/users.go:120.

path.description: The artifact the copied field is in.

pointer.description: The copied field, with each array index written as *.
